text:
Scale: the plate is about 660 px across, which I took as a standard 26 cm dinner plate, so roughly 25 px per cm.

The lasagna piece is about 290 px by 230 px, or roughly 11.5 cm by 9 cm. I estimated its height at 3.5 cm. That gives about 360 cm³, and at a density of about 0.95 g/cm³ it comes to roughly 300 g. It looks like part of it has been eaten, so I lowered the estimate to about 260 g. The tomato sauce on top is a thin layer, so I counted about 40 g of it separately and left the lasagna at about 220 g.

The two chicken pieces look like skin-on thighs, or leftover pieces with the bones removed. Each is about 6 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm thick, so about 60 g each, or 120 g together.

The grated cheese on top is a light sprinkle, about 3 g.
